watch.summary: The streamer whiffs a Rocket League shot and sarcastically claims he missed on purpose because he doesn't like cheap goals.

beats.what: Whiffs the ball and claims it was intentional to avoid a cheap goal
Makes a save and taunts the opponent

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: I missed that because that was obviously my intention. I don't like cheap goals, bro.
watch.why: The comedy comes from the streamer's sarcastic cover-up after missing a simple play. His deadpan tone claiming it was a point of honor not to take 'cheap goals' makes the self-own amusing.
